# lsb-docs

Writing documentation, PR descriptions, and research writeups for LandSandBoat and FFXI. Use when drafting or editing anything under docs/, a wiki page, a PR description, or a writeup of what a packet capture showed. Covers sourcing a claim, dating behaviour to an era, keeping retail separate from LSB, marking unverified data, and reporting numbers.

See [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) for the full instructions, and the [repo README](../../README.md) for how skills are installed.
